highlights.headline: WM uses real-time telematics and connected fleet technology to cut repair/maintenance costs and improve routing efficiency.
highlights.quote: real-time telematics are helping us anticipate and resolve vehicle issues faster, reduce downtime, and streamline maintenance scheduling
highlights.metric: 70 bps improvement in repair and maintenance cost as a percentage of revenue

highlights.headline: Williams is building natural gas infrastructure (Socrates project) to support AI data center power demand.
highlights.quote: we began construction on the Socrates Power Innovation project and we remain on track for bringing that project in service in 2026 as Williams supports our nation in winning the race for artificial intelligence

highlights.headline: Walmart deploying Sparky AI assistant in its app for customer shopping, discovery, reorders, and returns
highlights.quote: Sparky is the customer-facing assistant you see smiling at the bottom of our app. Today's Sparky takes us from traditional search to intelligent AI-powered assistants.

highlights.headline: WTW reports 75% reduction in routine work from AI tools; also deploys AI voicebots, chatbots, and an AI-driven job leveling tool for clients.
highlights.quote: In some instances, we've seen a 75% reduction in routine work and processing time. In other areas, AI-infused voicebots, chatbots, and guided digital experiences are enhancing the client experience
highlights.metric: 75% reduction in routine work and processing time

highlights.headline: Yum! Brands sent 200M+ AI-generated marketing communications in 2025, delivering up to 5x incrementality vs. traditional approaches.
highlights.quote: Over 200 million AI-generated communications have been sent this year, delivering up to 5 times incrementality compared to traditional approaches.
highlights.metric: 5x incrementality vs. traditional approaches; 200M+ AI-generated communications sent

highlights.headline: Zimmer Biomet acquiring Monogram Technologies for AI-driven semi/fully autonomous robotic surgery platform (mBôs).
highlights.quote: we announced a definitive agreement to acquire Monogram Technologies, which is the company behind mBôs, the robot with semi and fully autonomous AI-driven robotic capabilities

highlights.headline: Zebra references AI-powered modern store solutions and AI-based frontline agents as use cases for its portfolio and the Elo acquisition.
highlights.quote: the modern store from a Zebra perspective really powered by AI... the deployment of AI-based agents on the frontline are examples of new opportunities that Zebra and Elo can pursue together
